author: KEXP
description: Australian singer-songwriter Courtney Barnett continues to stun as a deft lyricist and virtuosic guitarist. Our latest in-studio session invites her to share a live performance of "Mantis" and more off her fourth studio album  'Creature of Habit.'
title: Courtney Barnett performs "Mantis" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG presents Courtney Barnett performing live in the KEXP studio. Recorded September 12, 2025.

Songs:  
Stay In Your Lane 00:40
Mantis 04:19
Mostly Patient 09:26
Sugar Plum 13:23

Courtney Barnett - Guitar, Vocal
Stella Mozgawa - Drums
Bones Sloane - Bass

Host: Cheryl Waters
Audio Engineer: Kevin Suggs
Mastering Engineer: Matt Ogaz

Cameras: Jim Beckmann, Carlos Cruz, Scott Holpainen & Luke Knecht
Editor: Jim Beckmann
